entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...So, why come here? Aren't you under[n]the care of another hospital?
entries.uk: ...То чому ви прийшли сюди? Хіба вас[n]не лікують в іншій лікарні?

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: I've heard rumors about this place.[n]I'd like for you to examine her.
entries.uk: Я чув чутки про це місце.[n]Я б хотів, щоб ви її оглянули.

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: She was diagnosed with bronchitis,[n]but the medicine she was given [n]hasn't been working at all.
entries.uk: Їй діагностували бронхіт, але ліки,[n]які їй дали, зовсім[n]не допомагають.

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: She has a fever that won't go away[n]and she's losing weight because[n]she's not hungry...
entries.uk: У неї температура, яка не спадає,[n]і вона худне, бо не має[n]апетиту...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: A young girl losing weight is definitely[n]not good.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You should go to a bigger hospital. I can't[n]provide a thorough examination here.
entries.uk: Вам варто піти до більшої лікарні.[n]Я не можу тут провести повне обстеження.

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: We've been going to a big hospital![n]A university hospital in East Shinjuku!
entries.uk: Ми й ходимо до великої лікарні![n]Університетської, у Східному Сіндзюку!

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: But all they tell us is that it's persistent[n]bronchitis!
entries.uk: Але там нам кажуть тільки,[n]що це затяжний бронхіт!

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...A university hospital in East Shinjuku?

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: The doctor there performs exams like[n]he's on an assembly line. I think he's[n]famous or something...
entries.uk: Лікар там оглядає, як на конвеєрі.[n]Здається, він якийсь відомий...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: A famous doctor, huh?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I'm just a general practitioner out here[n]in the sticks. As you can see, I don't even[n]have any staff.
entries.uk: Я лише терапевт тут, на околицях.[n]Як бачите, у мене навіть персоналу[n]немає.

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: W-Wait! I've heard there's a medicine[n]that can only be acquired here!
entries.uk: З-зачекайте! Я чув, що є ліки,[n]які можна дістати тільки тут!

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: Please! I'll pay you! Please, at least just[n]examine her!
entries.uk: Прошу вас! Я заплачу! Будь ласка, хоча б[n]огляньте її!

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: H-Hold on.

entries.speaker: Sick Girl
entries.en: *cough* *cough*

entries.speaker: Sick Girl
entries.en: Doctor... My chest really hurts...
entries.uk: Лікарко... У мене дуже болить у грудях...

entries.en: You'll be okay.
Dr. Takemi will help.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: That's a VERY irresponsible thing to say...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: What!?

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: Doctor...!

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: *sigh* ...Fine.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Is your vision blurry? How about your[n]throat, does it hurt? Hm. No signs of[n]swelling.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Are you sure you've told me everything[n]about her symptoms and treatments[n]you've tried so far?

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: Yes, I'm sure!

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Hmmm...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Hello, Uehara-san? Is Dr. Schweitzer[n]there?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: There's something I'd like to ask him[n]about a case that was in last month's[n]medical journal.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I see. Guess the ones in stock will[n]have to do...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: There's a shelf by the reception desk.[n]Bring the contents of the second drawer[n]into the exam room.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You'll need to help me administer[n]the medicine.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Also, bring the beaker with the red label[n]in the fridge, a towel, wash basin, and[n]measuring spoon...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Well, what are you waiting for?[n]Get moving!

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: Th-Thank you so much! I didn't expect[n]her to recover so quickly...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: It was a very unique strain of an infectious[n]disease. It can't be detected by[n]conventional exams.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I temporarily suppressed the symptoms.[n]We'll make adjustments as her condition[n]improves.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Okay, that'll be one million yen[n]for today.

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: A-A million yen!?

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: Th-That's outrageous! You're completely[n]taking advantage of...

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: I mean, all right... I agreed to pay.

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: You don't... take credit cards... do you?

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: I'll go withdraw some cash right now!

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Huh? Wait, you're actually going to pay?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: By the way, that famous doctor you[n]mentioned earlier... Was it Medical[n]Chief of Staff Oyamada?

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: Yes... are you familiar with him?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...I knew it.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: In that case, I'll make this free of charge.

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: F-Free!?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Hehe.
You seem happy.[clr 27]
You're so kind.
Why free?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Doesn't it feel good? Treating his patient[n]without permission.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Not really.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: But there IS a certain amount of[n]satisfaction in treating his patient[n]without permission.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: It's kind of funny, right? Having treated[n]his patient without permission.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...By the way, thanks to your outburst[n]earlier...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I'm going to perform a very special exam[n]on you today...

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: So, is he your... assistant? He seems[n]awfully young...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Yes, my assistant... guinea pig.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: He's about to put in a LOT of hard work[n]today. Aren't you?
It feels like my bond with Takemi[n]is growing even deeper...
entries.uk: Здається, мій зв'язок з Такемі[n]стає ще глибшим...

entries.speaker: Sick Girl
entries.en: Um, Doctor? Can I go back to[n]school now?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Not for a while. You need to start eating[n]and regain your strength first.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Can you do that for me?

entries.speaker: Sick Girl
entries.en: Yes! Thank you, Doctor!

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Don't mention it...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Your turn. I wonder what kind of[n]response you'll have this time...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Maybe you won't even be able to[n]make it home...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Okay, good work today.
